proofs.parity_right_inverse: Put Q_ij into A_ij for i<j and zero elsewhere; B=0. Then A+B+A^T+B^T=Q.
proofs.parity_kernel: The map has domain dimension 2N^2 and image dimension N(N-1)/2, so kernel dimension (3N^2+N)/2. A basis consists of (Eij,Eij) and (Sij,0), with Sij the symmetric diagonal/off-diagonal basis.
proofs.C_only_kernel: For C=A+B, C->C+C^T has the symmetric-matrix kernel of dimension N(N+1)/2; its image is all symmetric zero-diagonal matrices.
proofs.log_join: Finite per-tag canonical maximum is associative, commutative and idempotent. Pure materialization is a deterministic function of that map and its fixed base.
proofs.folding: Each gate operation has the same operands as the parity DAG. Precedence supplies their values before execution; induction over cycles preserves every DAG value despite gate reuse.
proofs.non_Zeno: With fixed h>0 and finitely many events per integer epoch, a finite physical interval contains finitely many epochs and events. No runtime filter is used.

scope: The AST primitives are rational boxes and axis half-spaces; finite arrangement evaluation implements their exact regular-closed Boolean semantics.
The sampled geometry response is an explicit finite observation, not exact optical path length, volume, distance or arbitrary black-box geometry.
Rational attenuation and heat exchange are backward-Euler consistency maps, not exact exponential flows.
The exact physical source ledger includes event-induced stiffness work, port work and incoming/outgoing beam energy.
Physical replica convergence here is fixed-base replay of the same activated event history, not incremental arrival-order evolution.
The gate schedule proves logical functional equivalence and its declared synchronous latency, not measured RC behavior or a hardware speedup.
The general local/global composition and continuation assumptions are stated in v15_composition_audit.md.
